name: client-portal
description: Client Portal — an open-source client-portal and invoicing example app for Adminium.

scripts.build:surface:staff: VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=staff tsc -b && VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=staff vite build --base=/apps/clients/staff/ --outDir dist-surface/clients/staff
scripts.build:surface:customer: VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=customer tsc -b && VITE_ADMINIUM_SURFACE_SIDE=customer vite build --base=/apps/clients/customer/ --outDir dist-surface/clients/customer
scripts.build:surface: npm run build:surface:staff && npm run build:surface:customer
